description: Empirical evaluation on Elsevier peer-reviewed lung cancer study (Procedia Computer Science 2025)

questions.question: What dataset combination was used in this study, and how many total CT and PET/CT images were analyzed after preprocessing?
questions.expected_answer: Combined LIDC-IDRI and Lung-PET-CT-Dx datasets; 53,688 images after manual preprocessing.

questions.question: What are the overall detection accuracies of the three-stage pipeline compared to standalone YOLOv11?
questions.expected_answer: The three-stage pipeline achieved an overall detection accuracy of 89.98%, whereas standalone YOLOv11 achieved 90.35%.

questions.question: Which company developed YOLOv11 and what previous architecture does it improve upon?
questions.expected_answer: YOLOv11 was developed by Ultralytics and improves upon YOLOv8.

questions.question: Who originally addressed the loss of spatial hierarchies in pooling operations by introducing CapsNet?
questions.expected_answer: Sabour et al. addressed the loss of spatial information by introducing the Capsule Network (CapsNet).

questions.question: Which histological tumor subtype showed the highest percentage increase in its share among False Negatives compared to its original representation in the test dataset, and what specific architectural limitation of the pipeline is hypothesized to cause this discrepancy?
questions.expected_answer: Adenocarcinoma showed an increase of 4.84 percentage points (from 66.20% in the test dataset to 71.04% among False Negatives), hypothesized to be caused by limitations in bounding box generation and the CapsNet architecture.

questions.question: What imaging modalities does CapsNet utilize and evaluate in the lung cancer classification pipeline?
questions.expected_answer: CapsNet uses and evaluates CT scans and PET/CT imaging modalities.

questions.question: What resolution are the cropped candidate nodules scaled to before being passed to the second-stage CapsNet?
questions.expected_answer: Cropped candidate nodule images are scaled to 128x128 pixels.

questions.question: Which institutions are the authors affiliated with in this research paper and where are they located?
questions.expected_answer: The authors are affiliated with Aalen University of Applied Sciences in Aalen, Germany and Klinikum Stuttgart in Stuttgart, Germany.

questions.question: How does Cropped Image CapsNet compare with Full Image CapsNet across accuracy and precision metrics?
questions.expected_answer: Cropped Image CapsNet outperforms Full Image CapsNet in nodule classification accuracy, precision, and recall.

questions.question: What is the three-stage detection pipeline sequence described from initial input to final diagnosis?
questions.expected_answer: Stage 1 uses YOLOv11 for initial nodule bounding box detection, Stage 2 uses CapsNet for verification and false positive reduction, and Stage 3 uses YOLOv11 for final subtype classification.
